author: HubLabs
description:
HubEgo-100K
	

A 100,000-hour dataset of first-person video of skilled manual work, recorded by Hub contributors: building sites, workshops, salons, kitchens, shops, warehouses and homes, released in stages. This first release has 10,124 hours of RGB + IMU from 12,227 contributors, in LeRobot and MCAP formats.
Paper: HubEgo-100K: In-the-Wild Egocentric Video of Skilled Work for Robot Learning (arXiv:2611.21938 [cs.RO])


	
		
	
	
		Highlights
	


Real work, in the wild: No staged… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/HubLabs/HubEgo-100K.
